review_description: The team started off with a very friendly and professional introduction and used their knowledge and experience to recommend me an ideal setup which wasn't beyond my needs. I asked for an extra battery and they immediately provided a quote which was discounted due to being installed at the same time etc.The installation day came and the team showed up in time, they were all polite and tidy. They had a few unexpected problems which happens in this field, but they didn't take shortcuts and got the job done. My father in-law is an electrician and said the cable work etc. was all tidy and professional.The final product is beyond my expectations, the team showed me how to set up the app and explained all of the terminology to me so I can now manage my solar/battery set up by myself.My final note is that I had used First Choice Solar about 8 years ago for my house solar panels, and had the same great experience last time. That's why I chose them this time to add more panels and batteries.
Very professional, On time, neat & tidy, respectful and a great bunch of guys. I would use again and recommend.

Very fast response to initial enquiry with a site visit within a couple of days and quotes immediately afterwards. Price was a little higher than others but longevity of the company, positive reviews and flexibility to my requirements won them the sale.The install went well with a good sized crew that got the majority of the work done and the system functional in one day, with a short visit a couple of days later to finish off a couple of things. Quality of the install and cleanup afterwards was very good. The lead of the crew was very experienced, and made sure the work was done to a high standard.All of the grid connection and approvals were handled by the installation company and commissioning and setup of the system was fast and efficient. I didn't need much in the way of help with the system as I had been researching it for a while but they still took the time to go through the correct shutdown and startup procedure with me.

We selected First Choice Solar because they had the best price by far for what we wanted however it was only after we paid the deposit that we found that the gear (GoodWe) they were going to install was currently not on Amber Energys list of approved inverters/batteries and that may have changed our decision.Communication - After we paid the deposit we heard absolutely nothing and it was only after I called them 2 weeks later that we found out that the application had been lodged to Energex in my name when my wife is the energy account holder. The application was relodged under her name and again we heard nothing for another 2 weeks when I contacted them to find out what was happening. It seems that because I expressed how unhappy I was with their lack of communication the installation was fast tracked and today I am happy to say that we have a new hybrid inverter and 20kw of battery storage. I appreciate that they are really busy with the new Govt subsidy now available however they really need to improve communication with their customers even if it is just to say your application has been received, we have forwarded it to Energex for approval and we will get back to you in 2 weeks to let you know how it is progressing. In doing this the customer knows that something is happening and has a date by which something else is going to happen.Installation - Could not be happier with Luke and Jake, the whole process took about 5 hours and Luke worked with me as far as my requirements were concerned. He was extremely professional and kept me up to date with progress how it would affect us by having the power off etc. and throughly tested the whole system before he left. He also showed me how to use the GoodWe app to my advantage
Added a battery and new Hybrid inverter to my existing system.First class service even sent workers around on the weekend when the install day was a wash out.Highly recommended

Troy from sales was helpful and good to deal with. Installation looks to be neat and tidy and they cleaned up after they finished. We are waiting for the grid connection, which will happen in a few days.

First Choice Solar have fitted our Solar System a couple of years ago and just recently our KWH battery system.Their workmanship and back up service is second to none and nothing is too much trouble.Highly recommend for any Solar and Battery install.

The team from sales through to installation were professional and very detailed, walked us through multiple options and post install understanding of how to use the system and features.Great to deal with, great responses.

First choice were in contact at every step.Great customer service.  Installer was very pleasant and helpful. Installation was commenced within 2 weeks and System working well.  This was an upgrade to a larger system.
I was happy from start to finish  with every aspect of my experience with First Choice Solar.

The sales & quoting process was helpful & informative (I re-checked against new info about Sigen on the Solar Quotes website).The installation was prompt, neat & tidy, their tradies were polite, helpful and informative.Their customer service organised the necessary paperwork etc.
Very attentive and supportive throughout. Installation was on time and professionally performed by a great team. Disruption was minimal. So far am very happy with the GoodWe solution
All parts of the application process was excellent with quick prompt answers to all questions that I had.

We were very happy with the process of Solar Quotes. Jake and the team from First Choice Solar did a great job installing and explaining the system to us. We wouldn’t hesitate recommending them to anyone at all.
Nice and helpful salesman.  Amazing install team.  Easy dealing.  Helpful admin team
Polite, punctual and professional. Excellent communication during process, sales person was electrician, could answer all my technical questions)

First Choice Solar, was very knowledgeable with their product with gave us the best price and system, without putting other  company's down.  We are making power from very early in the morning to last thing in evening, we are very happy, with their advice

The quote was ok but i felt it could have been explained better, because of this I picked the wrong quote initially. However the installers on the day were flexible and fixed my error. The system itself is fine the installers  were polite tidy and on time. I did get a very quick demo on how to use the app but it was basic and I actually have no idea how to use it beyond being able to see if it's working and I'm not sure who to call for follow up support. Wasn't terrible experience just could of been better. Hopefully it saves me money.

I recently had a fantastic experience with First Choice Solar and couldn't be happier with the quality of service they provided! from start to finish, the entire team went above and beyond to ensure we had a top-notch solar system installed.Bobby, our sales rep, was incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to explain everything in detail, helping us choose the perfect system for our home. He was patient with all our questions and made the whole process feel seamless.When it came to the installation, Jake, the lead installer, and his crew did an amazing job. They were professional, efficient, and made sure everything was installed to the highest standard. We really appreciated their attention to detail.Finally, the customer service team at First Choice Solar was always responsive and helpful, keeping us informed every step of the way.We are thrilled with our new solar system and would highly recommend First Choice Solar to anyone looking for quality solar solutions. A huge thanks to Bobby, Jake, and the entire team for making it such a great experience!

First choice solar got in touch with me almost instantly after recommendation from SolarQuotes. Matt (Director & Electrician) was at my home to do an in person quote the next day.There was no pushiness or salesmanship, he was able to provide factual answers to all my questions and provided me detailed and itemised quotes (only company out of 6 that I obtained quotes from to breakdown the pricing).Installation occurred within 2 weeks. The team was able to facilitate placement of the inverter inside my garage and minimise visible cables externally. The electrician on the day (Warren) answered all my questions and ensured that I could access the inverter and the catch control via the apps before leaving.The customer service from the administrative team was great. All of the warranties and instructions regarding ongoing management and servicing were provided to me a week after installation.I would feel confident going back to them if any issues arise in future and for installation of battery in the future.Great experience
Great experience from advice on system to quote and install.  Team were friendly and easy to work with.

The system isn’t generating the power it should be. Problems with the install where panels were not turned on once investigated.Technicians attending again this morning and think the inverter may be the problem.

Super helpful and up-front throughout sales and installation. Not sales-pitchy or pushy. Answered all of my questions promptly, even on weekends! Quick and efficient install, and they took care of everything.
The company was flexible with the location of the equipment and completed the job without a fuss . a nice neat installation (I'm a electrician)

Sale person was efficient and informative. Didn’t try to bulls**t me and when I came back to them with some additions to the quote, they over provide at a cheaper rate. I couldn’t have been happier. They even threw in a pressure wash of the whole roof for free!!!Installer was on time and kept me up to date with the progress. We went through the installation up front so I knew what they were installing was what we’d agreed at the sale. Very professional installers. They even moved some previously cracked roof tiles around so that any leaks would be around the eves and not the ceiling.They set up the app on my phone and showed me how to use it. They took me through the new system and explained everything quite clearly.And they cleaned up after themselves well.Overall I was happy with the whole experience.

We were hesitant to install solar panels based on some negative feedback about the process we had received from some friends.However the team at First Choice Solar have been fantastic. They have been knowledgeable, reliable and professional every step of the way.

Close neighbours in our gated community recommended First Choice Solar to us recently and, from the very start, we knew we were in good hands. Matt came to advise us, and answered our endless questions with great patience and without the ‘hard sell’.  His itemised quote was received within an hour of him leaving us!!Installation day arrived a few weeks later - & the sun actually shone after days of rain!!  Warren, Scott & Ash, the installers, arrived spot on time and proved to be a great team.  They were polite, friendly, & were happy to answer yet more of our questions - they were a joy to deal with.  They set to work immediate and, with just one very short break, they had the system up and running in no time at all.  Warren, the electrician, helped us with the download of the monitoring app and explained how to use the various aspects of the system before leaving!  All in all the installation was completed by 12.45 p.m…..a job that we had anticipated would take all day!!  Such was the efficiency of their efforts. Thank you, boys.  Another job well done & two very happy customers.Kristina in Customer Service was amazing throughout the whole process and kept us informed every step of the way with no prompting or chasing on our part.  First Choice Solar organised the grid connection on our behalf - we were told at the start that we wouldn’t have to do anything - and we didn’t!!  Everything seemed to work like clockwork and we feel extremely happy & fortunate to have found a company that actually does what it promises to do and without any hassles.Well done to Peter, Matt & all the team!  We will have no hesitancy in recommending First Choice Solar to anyone requiring the very best of service, excellent tradesmanship & a genuine philosophy of pride in doing things honestly and efficiently.

i didn't think service like this was still around, on time ,well mannered, had all the right gear, knew what they were doing and got into it straight away .stopped for a bite and were finished in a few hours.the panels i have bought this time are putting out twice as much as before and its safe to say i am over the moon.i will aways recommend 1st choice solar to  all my friends.
From the sales person, installation team and office staff, all were very friendly and professional, nothing was to much trouble.Differently recommend First Choice Solar
Process was easy. Were some delays due to rainy weather.

From start to what I hope is finish (ie nothing goes wrong) I cannot fault FCS. The sales person was punctual and personable and recognised my needs. The quote was very competitive. Another company recommended by Solar Quotes sadly was lacking in all the above and i am happy to give phone feedback on this to SQ.The admin team both before and after installation were courteous and responsive. I did not have to wait for any paperwork at all. This is in sharp contrast to other companies I asked for quotes.The installation exceeded expectations. The chaps turned up on time, were polite and very respectful, and worked very hard to finish the job. Any queries that I am aware of were addressed with me prior to doing anything, eg did I want the foxtel box, tv aerial etc.The customer service was excellent altogether. I only had to sign an electronic document for them to obtain some rebates as explained to me by them - everything else was handled by them and all I had to do was learn about how the app works and enjoy my new solar battery, inverter and panel installation.Absolutely would recommend this company - not only for all of the above reasons but also because I am based in a semi rural area and it is hard to get reliable people to come out this far. And I can’t speak for how FCS would handle any future problems, but I was left with the phone number of the team leader and would expect the same level of service to be offered in case of any difficulties. It is unusual to find a company so trustworthy. THANK YOU!

Right from the beginning Bobby went through everything, made recommendations, and listened to our needs. Understood what our goal was with having the system installed, he understood where we wanted the system installed and said he would accommodate our needs and could make it happen without compromising on the quality. We had additional solar panels installed and the battery.We liked that this was a family run business and has been around for many years, that was also reassuring that they are not one of these companies who disappear after a few years.The installation was quick, the team was friendly, punctual and cleaned up afterwards.Customer Service was great, answered all my questions, organised everything from start to finish.Fantastic Service, I would highly recommend First Choice Solar to all our family and friends and anyone looking at having a battery or solar panels installed. 100% satisficed Customer.

The salesperson was friendlyDealing with the administrative office staff was greatThe installers were very knowledgeable and finished the installation within a few hoursAfter installation care was also very good
process was easy, we had delt with this company before , locally owned, product was as expected and they delt with all the red tape

I can't recommend this company more highly. It's so rare to have such professional, helpful and friendly experience.It started with the quotation. Once we got in contact with them they sent someone out the next day. The person doing the quote was extremely knowledgeable and took the time to present a range of options as well as understand our electricity use, and then suggested a system based on that, without trying to oversell us on a more expensive system that we didn't need.They then assisted us greatly in the complicated process of applying for the Queensland battery grant, and were able to arrange installation just a few days after our application was approved.Finally the team they sent to install remove the old inverter, install the new one and the battery was equally fantastic. They made great efforts to keep everything safe as well as neat and tidy. The final result looks great.I only wish more companies were as good as these guys.

I felt most comfortable dealing with a team who are electricians and know their stuff. The proposal was the best in terms of location of the Inverter and battery. i liked that i did not have to worry about having replacement roof tiles available, they took care of that. They said that we should not see any wiring on the outside of the house is should all be internal.The Install went very well they were on time and on site all day until complete. any questions were clarified by the installers as they went. So far i have not noticed any external wiring.Afterwards same day we are producing alot of power during the daylight hours. i am glad we went with a battery as it is saving us drawing from the grid in the evening for as long as possible. We are currently waiting for our energy retailer to change over our meter. yet to negotiate a new power buy and sell price.

Michael from First Choice Solar came out to my home to quote, not just relying on satellite photos to establish what system would fit. My aim was to replace an old 3.3kW system for which the inverter and panel makers had long gone out of business. The advice on a proposed new system was comprehensive and informative, and the system was installed by a friendly team only a couple of weeks after I accepted the quote. They helped me get the app installed on my phone and computer, so at long last I can monitor what my system is doing. A minor hitch with a connection to the inverter was remedied later the same day by another member of the FCS team. I was given a manual for the inverter on the day, and have just been sent a wide-ranging manual for my new system. Altogether an excellent experience. Highly recommended.

It took a while to organise a site visit and a proper quote.  Had a great chat with their sales guy who answered every question I had.  Appreciated that the quote was itemised.The install was scheduled for two weeks after accepting the quote and they got it installed and commissioned very quickly.  Good communication and as far as I can tell it is very tidy with good workmanship.It all went very smoothly.  Great work!

Its nice to deal with a company that does what it says. Quotes, meetings, install - all as promised. So often things don't happen - even when promised but FCS were great. From the office staff to management to the actual installers - all excellent.

The quoting process was very efficient and informative.Installation seemed to go without a hitch in a very timely manner.  The whole team were very helpful and personable.Customer service excellent. Everything went very seemlessly including organising the grid connection

Sales person was polite and friendly.Installation process was smooth and installers very polite and friendly.Each process was explained to me and all the documentation was finalised by First Choice Solar.I recommended First Choice to my neighbours who have since had solar installed by them.
Quoting was straight forward.Installers were polite, on time and listened to our questions and requests. Install is clean.They organised grid connection, we had nothing else to do.

Very satisfied with installer, very good salesperson who willing to take in all of my questions and suggestions.The installation team was friendly and working efficiently. They let me know that a couple of tiles had been broken and asked if I had spares, which I luckily had. This is a strong good point as I can imagine someone could have found out this had happened and was discovering this after the first big rain.The electrician explained the system to me and how it was installed and helped me to install the app and get connected.

First Choice Solar exceeded my expectations throughout the installation process. Their team was not only knowledgeable but also incredibly efficient. From the initial consultation to the final setup, every step was handled with utmost professionalism. Their installers and engineers made sure to include everything I was looking for regarding full battery backup while keeping their quote competitive. The installers were punctual, courteous, and made sure to address any questions I had. Kudos to First Choice Solar for making the transition to solar power a pleasurable and hassle-free journey. I'm delighted with the seamless experience and would highly recommend First Choice Solar for their exceptional service.

These guys installed a 15kW goodwe three phase hybrid inverter but no battery (yet). And a Tesla wall charger. Also removed an existing 5kW single phase system. So far so good. Matt who came out and quoted was good and wasn’t afraid to have an opinion. I liked that the quote was itemised - the other companies didn’t do that. Left things tidy.

The guys at First Choice Solar were great, cheapest quote, also they were happy to accommodate some changes. They arrived on time and had the solar installed in a few hours, they explained how it all works and how the app works. Would recommend them to everyone.
First Choice solar provided a great experience and ultimately after looking at other providers came up tops on so many levels.

Jake and the boys did a fantastic job, because I wasn’t here at the start of the job the communication between myself and Jake was very professional, I have no hesitation in recommending first choice solar to anyone thinking of installing solar

Peter was fantastic in providing information, advising and guiding us through our system design and customisation during the quotation phase. Kristina and the rest of the administrative team provided thorough and timely communication throughout the process. On installation day, Jake, Scottie and Kye did an excellent job, with meticulous attention to detail, and were very professional, transparent, helpful and efficient. All in all, this was an excellent installation!

FIRST CHOICE SOLARNot possible to tell value for money or quality of the system until its proved itself over several yrsPrice $5200Recommended retaining current 3.8KW systemRecommended not getting a battery just yet - prices may come down in the new year plus after a full billing quarter we would be in a better position to confirm how much power we generated, put into the grid and thus would have a better idea of battery size required. The inverter they recommended is a hybrid so a battery can be addedGreat service and customer communication. Installed within a mth after initial contactInstalled within 6 hrs. Pilotte staff who cleaned up the area prior to leavingCompleted all liaison with Energex to remove off peak power & upgrade meter boxOnce a full billing cycle has been completed the owner will recommend which energy company will provide best value connection fees - feed in rates & overall costsQuotes not AcceptedINGOT Energy - did not come to house. Most expensive quote. Totally ignored our current 3.8LW syst that still works well. Did not follow up with usHALCOL ENERGY - visited house & was good. Included retaining current 3.8KW system. Price $6650

The team communicated well once the sale was done to keep me informed what was going to happen next, on the day of install the team arrived and explained the plan, got the install done and left my property nice and tidy, the system is in and working well thanks.
Service from start to finish excellent and nothing too much trouble.Seamless process from accepting quotation to installation.Peter, Jake and Team very professional service.

Andrew was only one of a few that took the time to visit my home and discuss my options.No pressure to sign and good honest advice using the best products available.Pat the electrician turned up when expected, explained all our options of installation of cables, switchboard anlterations  and where panels and inverter would be placed and promptly completed the job.Highly Recommended.
Installation went well, and in less time than was expected.

Came and gave detailed quote and followed up online. Would have been installed sooner but first date I was out all day. Turned upon time and were busy straight away, very quick. Still have to put cover on inverter and screen door to garage forgot to close, could have tidied up a bit better (but that's all tradies it seems). Organised connection with Energex but that is still to happen as Christmas period

Great consultant who worked out a system to suit our situation.  Quick install by nice folks. Unfortunately the system has some issues with function,  we are waiting for someone to attend and resolve that.  Otherwise would have higher customer service rating.

I am very satisfied with First Choice Solar installation and customer service. The materials used look and feel high quality, not only the panels and inverter, but the cabling and ducts all well placed and sealed. They discussed the plan and preferences for position of the inverter prior. The technicians were on time and available post-installation to clarify questions and help with anything. A few months after installation I had to contact them with a fault in the hot water relay, and they resolved the issue within the same day by coming to my property and replacing the device at no cost.In terms of the system itself it is indeed very efficient. Having the Catch Power relay device performing a smart control of the hot water system adds significantly to the energy bill savings. Overall great design.To sum up, if you are in the Gold Coast area looking for a quality affordable Solar System , look no further.I just wish I had a little more help with the energy companies, as I had to undergo a metering replacement and this experience can vary depending on which energy retailer you are with.

The quote processes were easy to understand, the installers were friendly and cleaned all areas before leaving. The installer also connected the unit into the grid and gave instructions on any future issues. Great service from start to finish. Thanks, First Choice Solar.

Purchased a property with existing solar system - ends up inverter not working (For quite a while)..called First Choice to obtain information and assistance on upgrading whole system (wanted someone locally based on GC) The team were punctual, professional and informative, discussed a range of options - we decided on an upgrade to a new inverter and new panels. The install was an excellent experience, the install team were very punctual, polite and professional. We had to delay panel install due to high winds and they were extremely apologetic but understandable given the safety issues. I only had to wait a day until they returned and were completed in approx 1.5 hrs for 16 panels, you can tell they have genuine experience in what they are dealing with- they also assisted with Catch Power app set up and monitoring on my phone, just really good guys to deal with. The support and admin staff at the office were also very helpful and we received a followup email with user guides and confirmation of meter registration the very next day. Lastly given we are in a duplex with a flat roof - the old panels were on a tilt and visible from the road, fairly unsightly - the new ones were laid flat and the building aspect looks so much better! I would highly recommend First Choice for your one stop solar needs on the Gold Coast, family businesses are always the best to deal with.

Happy with the system, the panels and inverter and working better than all my estimates that I based my decision on, and better than their estimates too. The only thing I’m not totally happy with is the catch power app is under reading about 5% so far (They are looking into the cause of that). And the Goodwe inverter app only measures production, not power imported and exported, so monitoring is not as good as expected. I would recommend them. I would use them again.

I would highly recommend First Choice for many reasons; quoting process, great and punctual installation, polite and patient customer service who helped me organise the grid connection after the install.

First Choice came to me through Solar Quotes and they were the first to contact me and organise a time to come prepare a quote. Bobby showed up for the quote and spent as much time as needed to answer all my questions (and I had many!). At the end, he planned a system that suited both my needs and my budget.Installation day came in just a few weeks and was another great experience, with an early TXT message confirming the team’s arrival time. Josh and the team showed up on time and did a great job in positioning the inverter, running wires to and from the roof and installing the panels on my three storey home. The whole installation looks very clean and they cleaned up all the bits of wire and debris after installation was complete.At the end, Josh explained how to operate the system, use the monitoring app and the Catch Solar Relay settings to control the water heater, and took his time to explain the next steps with my energy provider and to answer my last few questions.The system is performing flawless and overall this was the perfect experience I’d expect from a professional solar installation business.

I recently had Matt and the team at First Choice Solar take care of my solar panel installation. I heard their radio commercial and was hooked by the jingle. From the very beginning, their service was nothing short of impeccable. The quoting process was thorough and transparent, allowing me to make informed decisions about what I needed. The team's professionalism and attention to detail throughout the installation were truly impressive. They ensured that everything was set up perfectly and took the time to address any questions I had. The entire experience was seamless, and I couldn't be happier with the end results, already saving on my power bills. If you're looking for a reliable and customer-focused solar installation company, I highly recommend Matt and the First Choice Solar team."

First choice was the best to deal with from the start to finish. They were professional and installed super quick. After market support has been great as they have helped to answer any questions i have had,
The entire process from start to finish was excellent and I would highly recommend First Choice Solar

Super happy with the whole process. Quoting was easy and the installation was really well done. Wasnt the cheapest quote i got but i am super have with the product they installed. Highly recommend the team from First Choice.

Do yourself a favour, use First Choice Solar. The best customer service and experience you can imagine. No question is silly to ask and they always have the time of day for you. Incredibly professional.We have an older house in Broadbeach Waters (about 45yrs old) and our electrics box AND meter needed replacing. They took care of the whole project, from start to finish. They include USAGE monitoring as standard as that's something every solar customer should have at install, without question.Local Gold Coast family-run business with an expanding business for good reason with service such as this.Best value in town, best products on offer. They only offer you products they'd put on their own houses.
This is the 3rd system i have purchased from this installer each time i have moved house. Can't fault them and the system does what they say.
All aspects delivered as advertised.  Would have no hesitation in recommending this provider to others.

First Choice Solar were absolute professionals in every aspect of our dealings with them. They were friendly, efficient, communicative, and all the interactions we had with them had the crisp feeling of a well oiled machine. We got an extremely detailed and tailored quote immediately after the site inspection which was well explained by their representative, and the install was rapid and looks very neat. I've already recommended them to a friend in the area who is looking at solar too. Thanks First Choice Solar! Thanks to Solarquotes too, what a fantastic resource to get started on our solar journey.
Thanks to Matt who gave me expert advice to get the most efficient and right system on my house. It wasn't a sales pitch it was the right advice for my house. I would highly recommend. Thanks Cath

Sales process was simple, to the point and informative. Salesman came to house and talked through options, provided positives and negatives for both a smaller or larger system. Process was simple and order was well structured, simple to approve and understand.Installation was great. Connection to grid was all done and we were up and running on the day.

Very happy with the speed of initial contact happy with the priceVery happy with the ladies calling me for the booking dateVery happy with the boys who installed the systemso far the system is working well

After many quotes and much research, I should have just looked at the name and gone with them. They were great on price. Excellent on presales questions and making sure all my questions were answered. Best part was they didn't hide anything in the quote. It listed all items.Installation day came very quickly. The guys showed up on time and bounced up on the roof moving the old system up out of the way for the new one. They were done in short work and ran me though the app installs. Gave me a quick rundown of the system and gone. They even used a dustpan and brush. Not your usual electricians :)After sales service was great. Plenty of emails to get paperwork signed and then came my questions. Matt was happy to come back out an explain how to get the best out of the system.Would recommend these guys any day of the week.

The person doing the quote was a previous installer and certainly focused more on information than selling. I really appreciated the great communication and friendly contact at the office. The installers were on time and did great job. Only one small hiccup but that rectified from their end very quickly. Now Im saving heaps and enjoying my credits into the system rather than paying them!
Knowledgeable sales person. Efficient, on time installation. Only been in service two weeks. System is working as expected.

I hade used First Choice Solar twice now to install 6.4KW of solar panels. Both times I had a very good experiences with the quality of work, competitive pricing and installers that care. I just can’t say enough about my most recent installation. I would highly recommend First Choice Solar for all your solar needs.

Sale and quoting process was honest and better still, designed exactly for my property and needs. Quote took into account the angles, roof direction and shade, and didn't over-sell a solution just to fill the roof with panels. I was offered 3 different size options, with a clear breakdown of the benefits of each option. Matt wasn't pushy, didn't talk down the competition, and just spoke about the benefits of his company.Deposit to install process was a little under a week - and was all well-handled by the back-office team without any intervention or prompting. Received my bespoke manual/warranty pack within 2 business days after install with details photos of the components.The install itself I couldn't have asked for better. This was my biggest worry area considering we had just had our whole house and roof renovated. The team were professional, friendly and knew exactly what they were doing, working extremely well together, and well led by the electrician Nick. Gutter guards protected the paint, used all the right PPE and cleaned up as they went. Would go as far as saying they were the best trades we've had on our whole house renovation over the last 2 years.The system itself is generating maximum power from the first day, and is more than offsetting my daytime usage (even in some cloudy conditions). Overall very impressed and would highly recommend.
Over and above what we expected. We didn’t have to do a thing. Fantastic service in all areas at a great price.

So Peter knew exactly how to present thew value in his system to me and what I was hoping to achieve, which was ultimately Return on investment. He didn't try to over sell me, just worked out was the best value system and the performance to match. Of all the quotes it was most accurate to what I had worked out using the independent resources I got my hands on.Also installing a heat pump water system which I ordered late in the piece. this impacted getting he whole system installed but Nick and the guys that installed were excellent and still got me operational. last 10 panels get installed later but I was kept informed the whole time. Great referral from a mate and would happily refer to anyone.came in well under budget

We decided to go with First Choice Solar after Matt came round and explained everything without being pushy and their price was the most competitive.   We found the whole team from Matt, the Office Staff and installers totally professional, on time, friendly and helpful and also left the site tidy.   We feel we have a quality system installed by a first-class company for a great price and cannot recommend them enough.

From start to finish I had a good experience with Matt and First Choice Solar when they installed an expanded array and replaced a failing inverter on our house roof in Palm Beach. I found Qelec trading as First Choice via the Green Connect Brokerage advertising on eBay. The GC sales representative was friendly. We communicated by email and occasionally by phone (not easy to get by phone). I found the lack of detailed information a bit frustrating but the price was amazing. $6990 for a 5KW system advertised. Initially I expected the advertised BYD panels. As I went to buy I was told they were out of stock for BYD and was I could have 22 Lightway 235 Watt panels. The day of the install I got a message from the First Choice installer that 22 panels wouldn't fit on my roof. I was forgiving because all the sales folk I spoke to (about 6 counting Solar Quotes) said 22 panels for 5 KW would be fine. I contacted the GC sales rep and asked for a new quote. I was told I could have 18 Lightway 230 Watt panels. I said yes to this and was told they were out of Lightway stock and we were back to BYD but these were only 215 watt panels. I asked if they had an up market option and was offered Trina 250 watt Panels which I accepted. The install was done and I got my 18 Trina panels and a 4.4KW Samil inverter for $7277. I would have been happier if I had been offered the 5KW Samil and we could have easily have fitted 2 more panels for the 5 KW system I was originally after. Still at the end of the day I have a system which in winter with a tree shading the morning sun gives me around 17KW per day. In my direct dealings with First Choice the service was great. Going via the Green Connect brokerage it was a little painful.

I shopped around. Received 4 face to face quotes and 3 over the phone or internet. The plan is make sure you understand what the salespeople are talking about so you know what they are talking about and whether there system is value. E.g. one group wanted to sell us a 3kw system only based on a rebate of 74cents but the system was overpriced. One wanted to give us a discount for allowing advertising in our front yard. Once again the system was overpriced. Whatever you do ask Finn Peacock about the quality of either the panels or inverter. He was great. In regards to First Solar they were good. Explained that you need to discount what you generate depending on where the panels are located and allow further discount because the invertter and panels need power to work. Easy to contact and were able to work with us for installation date.
